name: Sunday School
overview: Sunday School reflects the biblical call to nurture and instruct children in the faith, as Proverbs 22:6 emphasizes training a child in the way he should go so he will not depart from it in old age. Jesus' welcoming of little children in Mark 10:14 highlights the importance of including them in the kingdom of God. The responsibility to teach and care for the church, purchased by Christ's blood, is entrusted to overseers who feed the flock (Acts 20:28). Through the study of Scripture, believers find hope and encouragement (Romans 15:4), and praising God together in His sanctuary (Psalms 150:1) underscores the communal and worshipful aspect of learning in Sunday School.
